tickerText: [TENNIS] Cincinnati R64: Tirante stuns Djokovic 2-6, 6-4, 6-4; Sabalenka, Gauff & Medvedev headline Sunday's order of play • [SQUASH] Evans vs Perez set for PSA Valencia final; Refaay & Hazem swept Kolkata Challenger titles • [BADMINTON] BWF Worlds open Monday in Delhi — Chinese contingent praises upgraded Indira Gandhi Stadium ahead of R64 • [PICKLEBALL] Seattle PPA Challenger final day — pro medal rounds at Sideout Tsunami as 482-player field wraps up • [TABLE TENNIS] WTT Europe Smash: three Chinese women reach semis; Lebrun brothers claim men's doubles title in Malmö

newsItems.title: Tirante Stuns Djokovic in Cincinnati
newsItems.excerpt: Argentina's Thiago Agustin Tirante rallied past No. 3 seed Novak Djokovic 2-6, 6-4, 6-4 in Cincinnati's Round of 64 — one of the biggest upsets on Day 1 of the WTA 1000 / ATP Masters 1000 event.

newsItems.title: Evans & Perez Set Valencia Final
newsItems.excerpt: Wales' Rhys Evans swept Abdulla Al-Tamimi while Spain's Ivan Perez rallied from 0-2 down to beat Sam Osborne-Wylde, setting up an all-European PSA Valencia Memorial Chimo Marmaneu final.

newsItems.title: Delhi Ready for BWF Worlds
newsItems.excerpt: The 30th BWF World Championships open Monday at New Delhi's Indira Gandhi Arena — India's first Worlds in 17 years, with PV Sindhu, Lakshya Sen and Satwik-Chirag leading the home charge.

newsItems.title: Seattle Challenger Final Day
newsItems.excerpt: The Carvana PPA Tour's Seattle Challenger concludes today at Sideout Tsunami — birthplace of pickleball — with pro medal rounds across five disciplines wrapping a 482-player weekend.
